review.notes: Extracted text of all 30 physical pages compared against the OCR markdown with a normalized line-presence scan (case/punctuation-insensitive); remaining scan flags were ligature artifacts or Dataset-Card Q&A text that is present in the markdown. Page-bottom strips of pages 1, 2, 4, 9, 10 and 24 rendered and visually verified for every reinserted footnote body; footnote 1's body and the two symbol notes were additionally confirmed in the reliable PDF text layer of the same footnote-rule blocks. The OCR dropped every numbered footnote body (1-13), both title-page symbol notes, the dagger markers on two author names, and the superscript-11 glyph (whose sentence was also hard-split into two paragraphs; re-joined). The three appendix code fences reproduce printed monospace generation listings and were left unchanged.
